svg.title: Precipitate with acetonitrile and redissolve in toluene
svg.desc: Precipitate with acetonitrile and redissolve in toluene. MA: four precipitation cycles. ODPA-derived workup: initial precipitation followed by three additional alternating clarification/precipitation iterations. Each clarification keeps toluene supernatant; each precipitation keeps product. Amounts and centrifuge settings unreported. Retained fraction: precipitated product; discard supernatant. Geometry and color are conceptual; selected operation quantities apply.
